title: 五官的立体度
description: 先看眼、鼻、唇之间的空间关系，再判断眉形需要怎样的存在感。
description_en: Look at the relationship between the eyes, nose and lips before deciding how much definition the brows need.

title: 量感与整体风格
description: 观察五官的大小、线条与整体量感，让眉形的粗细和轮廓与之协调。
description_en: Consider the scale and lines of the features when choosing brow thickness and contour.

title: 颧骨与面部轮廓
description: 结合颧骨高低和面部转折，讨论眉峰、眉尾与脸部轮廓的视觉关系。
description_en: Consider cheekbone prominence and facial contours when placing the arch and tail.

title: 眉眶骨与眉眼关系
description: 顺应原有骨骼结构，观察眉眶骨高低、眉眼距离和不同角度的比例。
description_en: Work with the existing bone structure, brow-to-eye distance and proportions from different angles.

title: 原生眉框架与毛流
description: 看框架、浓淡、毛质和生长方向，区分可以保留的部分与需要补充的部分。
description_en: Study the shape, density, texture and direction of existing hairs to decide what to retain and where to add detail.

title: 你希望呈现的气质
description: 自然、柔和、利落或更有存在感，都可以讨论。你的喜好是设计依据的一部分。
description_en: Understated, soft, defined or more expressive: your preferences are part of the brief.
